Type: tall six-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes; bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, classic
Materials: cherry veneer with flame grain, dark lacquered finish, slim metal pulls
Colors: dark reddish espresso brown, silver
Shape: tall narrow case, gently bowed drawer fronts, slatted open side panels, slender tapered legs, recessed bar pulls, elegant and upright
Feel: rich, refined, polished
Goes with: cream bedding, warm neutral walls, chrome accents; contemporary or transitional bedrooms

product.name: Pinzon Walthum 6-Drawer Chest
product.description: Beautiful chest has 6 drawers with French dovetail fronts and English backs on double wood glides Solid rubberwood and ash veneer with dark Java finish; brushed aluminum handles 75-pound capacity; larger drawers are 28-1/4 inches long by 14 inches deep by 6-1/4 inches high Coordinates with the Pinzon Walthum Bedroom Furniture Collection Measures 58 inches high by 34 inches wide by 20 inches deep
